witness_ex_end1.note: EX I4=1: source at end 1. Pairs with end2 — #1190 EX row.

witness_ex_end2.note: EX I4=2: source at end 2, the wrapper's spelling.

witness_ld_henries_per_m.note: LDTYP=2 with henries per METRE, the intended unit.
